deprecated_flag_sensor.title: Deprecated sensor detected
deprecated_flag_sensor.description:
The sensor `{entity_id}` is deprecated: value type 28 widgets, which report Enabled/Disabled, are now exposed as binary sensors with the same name.

Update your dashboards, templates, automations and scripts to use the binary sensor instead, then disable the deprecated sensor and restart Home Assistant.

deprecated_flag_sensor_used.title: Deprecated sensor detected
deprecated_flag_sensor_used.description:
The sensor `{entity_id}` is deprecated: value type 28 widgets, which report Enabled/Disabled, are now exposed as binary sensors with the same name.

It is used in the following automations or scripts:
{items}

Update those, along with any dashboards and templates that use it, to use the binary sensor instead, then disable the deprecated sensor and restart Home Assistant.

menu_code_rejected.title: Menu code not accepted
menu_code_rejected.description: The code configured for the controller's {menu_type} menu was not accepted, so that menu's controls are missing. Remove and re-add the integration to enter the code again. A wrong code looks exactly like no code, so it cannot be checked any other way.
